title: Tomato and Capsicum Shakshuka
subtitle: with Crusty Bread
description: When the warming aromas hit you, it's hard to resist dunking the crusty bread straight into this much-loved Middle Eastern dish. So go on - dive in!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Finely chop the onion. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove. Cut the capsicums into 1cm chunks, discarding the seeds and membrane. Finely chop the coriander, keeping the leaves and stems separate.

Soften capsicum: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Add the onion, garlic, capsicum, 2 tsp cumin and coriander spice blend (the remaining spice blend won't be used in this dish), season with salt and pepper and cook, stirring, for 6 mins or until softened.

Add tomatoes and simmer: Add the tomatoes, coriander stems, ¼ tsp sugar and 60ml (¼ cup) water to the capsicum mixture and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 7-8 mins until the sauce is thick and rich.

Cook eggs: Line an oven tray with foil then preheat the grill to medium-high. Using a spoon, make 2 shallow indents in the sauce. Carefully crack an egg into each hole. Cover with a lid and cook for 4-5 mins until the eggs are just cooked.

Serve up: Meanwhile, cut the bread roll in half horizontally and put on the lined tray. Brush the cut sides with 2 tsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper, then grill for 1-2 mins until warmed through and golden. Scatter the shashuka with the coriander leaves and serve with the crusty bread.
Make it yours: Combine some Greek-style yogurt with a little smoked paprika, then drizzle the smoky creamy sauce over the dish just before serving.
